title: Localization of the actual kernel conormal and unit
statement: Let g:X→Y be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], W⊂Y and U⊂X opens with g⁻¹W=U and h:U⊆g⁻¹W. Suppose i=g.resLE W U h:U→W is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let K=ker(O_Y→g_*O_X) be the actual module-sheaf kernel and N=P_g K [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let C=i_*P_i(i.ker.toModules), using the closed-immersion ideal module [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Give Γ(N,U) the Γ(W,top)-action through the open-section isomorphism W.topIso.hom and g.appLE. There exists a Γ(W,top)-linear equivalence e:Γ(C,top)≃Γ(N,U). For every s∈Γ(K,W), there is t∈Γ(i.ker.toModules,top) whose inclusion is W.topIso.inv of the included s, and e carries the local pullback-unit section of t to the restriction to U of the original pullback-unit section of s [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. No assumption that g is globally closed is made.

source.place: Tag 01R3 (1), (2), combined with Tags 00A0 and 0096; read online 2026-10-13

proof.text: On every open T of W form the map alpha from the restriction of the actual module-sheaf kernel K to O_W by restricting kernel.ι and composing with restrictUnitIso. The commutative resLE square and g inverse W = U identify the zero loci of the function maps g.app and i.app. The range_map_kernelι theorem and the closed-immersion kernel ideal section description show alpha factors through i.ker.toModules. Construct delta by kernel.lift. Its inclusion equation is kernel.lift_ι. Delta is bijective on sections: injectivity follows from the two kernel inclusions and the open function isomorphism, and surjectivity follows by transporting a local ideal section to a section killed by g.app. Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app makes delta an isomorphism.

For an arbitrary module M, compose restrictAdjunction W.ι with the chosen tensor-pullback adjunction of i, and compose the tensor-pullback adjunction of g with restrictAdjunction U.ι. Identify their right adjoints using pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr of resLE_comp_ι, and inverse pushforwardComp. leftAdjointUniq gives beta: restriction_W followed by tensorPullback i is isomorphic to tensorPullback g followed by restriction_U. Taking top sections and transporting U.ι image top = U gives E. Its scalar compatibility follows from Hom.app_smul, map_smul, and resLE_app_top, so E gives the required linear equivalence for the restricted module.

Evaluate unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app on W and s. Expand comp_unit_app and ofNatIsoRight_unit. Use naturality of beta on the equality morphism top → i inverse (W.ι inverse W), and naturality of the i-adjunction unit on top → W.ι inverse W. Compose the remaining restriction maps to obtain the unit equation for E. Finally apply tensorPullback i, pushforward i and evaluation to delta inverse and compose the resulting linear equivalence with E. Set t = delta applied to the transported s. The delta inclusion equation and naturality of kernel.ι prove the first equation; adjunction-unit naturality for delta inverse and delta hom_inv_id prove the second.

mathlib_searches.results: IdealSheafData.map_ker, ker_morphismRestrict_ideal, ker_ideal_of_isPullback_of_isOpenImmersion, and related ideal-sheaf statements. The restriction facts assume QuasiCompact g and concern the quasi-coherent ideal, not the actual module-sheaf kernel; none includes the conormal pullback unit identity.

The broad grep returned unrelated group/linear-algebra/probability kernels. A focused AlgebraicGeometry grep and project searches found no Mathlib conormal transport. Project nonempty_tensorPullback_open_kernel assumes the original morphism globally closed and supplies no unit identity.

lean.statement: theorem open_kernel_conormal_transport {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens) (U : X.Opens) (h : U ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ W) (hpre : g ⁻¹ᵁ W = U) [IsClosedImmersion (g.resLE W U h)] : let i := g.resLE W U h let K := kernel (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom) let N := (tensorPullback g).obj K let C := (pushforward i).obj ((tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) letI : Module Γ(W.toScheme, ⊤) Γ(N, U) := Module.compHom _ ((g.appLE W U h).hom.comp W.topIso.hom.hom) ∃ e : Γ(C, ⊤) ≃ₗ[Γ(W.toScheme, ⊤)] Γ(N, U), ∀ s : Γ(K, W), ∃ t : Γ(i.ker.toModules, ⊤), i.ker.toModulesι.app ⊤ t = W.topIso.inv ((kernel.ι (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom)).val.app (op W) s) ∧ e (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)).unit.app i.ker.toModules).app ⊤ t) = N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).unit.app K).val.app (op W) s)
